open_points.subject: FlowEdge guard propagation to a node input also supplied by a FlowConstant
open_points.text: “A node one of whose input ports has every incoming edge disabled by its guard, or coming from a skipped node, is not executed and is recorded `skipped_by_guard`” conflicts with M16’s “delivered to one input port like any other value.”
open_points.question: Does a FlowConstant supplying the port prevent `skipped_by_guard`, and may a port have both a constant and incoming edges?
options: A delivered constant prevents skipping; composition may allow constant plus edges subject to single-delivery proof
A delivered constant prevents skipping, and composition refuses any port that also has an incoming edge
The rule considers only edges, so a port whose edges are unavailable is skipped even if a constant targets it
open_points.default_guess: A delivered constant prevents skipping, and composition refuses any port that also has an incoming edge.

open_points.subject: Meaning of a skipped source node
open_points.question: Which NodeExecution statuses make a source a “skipped node” for this propagation rule: only `skipped_by_guard`, or also `upstream_failed` and any other non-executed state?
options: Every source node that produced no output, including failed executions

open_points.subject: Guard skipping of mapped nodes
open_points.text: “A node one of whose input ports has every incoming edge disabled by its guard, or coming from a skipped node, is not executed and is recorded `skipped_by_guard`” does not say whether “node” means the whole mapped node or one mapped element execution.
open_points.question: For a mapped node, is `skipped_by_guard` determined and recorded for the whole node or separately for each `map_index`, and what record exists when the unavailable port is the `map_over` port so there are no elements from which to mint indices?
options: Decide per element; if `map_over` itself is unavailable, create one node-level skipped record without a map index
Skip and record the mapped node once as a whole whenever any required port is wholly unavailable
Create skipped records only for known map indices; if `map_over` is unavailable, create no NodeExecution records
open_points.default_guess: Decide per element; if `map_over` itself is unavailable, create one node-level `skipped_by_guard` record without a map index.
